title: 40mm Road Race Tyres & Tavelo Grow Review | NERO Show

takeaways.text: Frames and wheels were supplied free by Tavelo with no affiliate deal. A 2.1 in Thunder Burt measuring about 54 mm fitted, with plenty of front room and a few millimetres at the rear; Tavelo claims 55 mm front and 50 mm rear.
1× only (no front-derailleur mount); Tavelo lists a 50T maximum ring, which the builder thought had room to go larger. The largest XXL size rides like a big 58.
FIDLOCK down-tube storage sits behind the bottle cage and comes with a multi-tool; the shop found tolerances and facing fine.
A titanium saddle-clamp bolt stripped its head during a routine angle adjustment; Tavelo's co-founder said a deeper, tighter head would follow and sent a replacement.

On the road with 40 mm slicks (measuring about 42 mm) it felt smooth but steered noticeably slower than a race bike; off-road the long, stable feel suited fast descents but needed more effort in tight turns.

The second tester found it stiff with very good power transfer, without off-road discomfort on 50 mm tires at low pressure; he would choose it over his previous gravel race bike for its tire clearance and storage.
Frameset quoted at US$1,650 in June 2026, with the bar priced separately.

disclosure: The episode says the frame and wheels were supplied free and states that the reviewers have no affiliation.
summary: Extended on-road and gravel test discussion of the Grow platform, including fit and use-case context; the review build is not this site's estimated build.
